items.exampleEn: Contrary to what I expected, the test was easy.
items.exampleZh: 和我預期的相反，考試很簡單。

items.exampleEn: The long trip was worthwhile because the view was amazing.
items.exampleZh: 這趟長途旅行很值得，因為景色太美了。

items.exampleEn: The advertisement misled customers about the price.
items.exampleZh: 那則廣告在價格上誤導了顧客。

items.exampleEn: Making good bread requires a lot of patience.
items.exampleZh: 做出好麵包需要很多耐心。

items.exampleEn: It was a difficult decision, but I chose to stay.
items.exampleZh: 那是個困難的決定，但我選擇留下來。

items.exampleEn: Driving fast increases the risk of accidents.
items.exampleZh: 開快車會增加發生意外的風險。

items.exampleEn: We need a new approach to this problem.
items.exampleZh: 我們需要用新的方法來處理這個問題。

items.exampleEn: The weather will determine whether we go or not.
items.exampleZh: 天氣將決定我們去不去。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't take any risks when you drive in the rain.
items.sentenceZh: 下雨開車時請不要冒任何險。

items.audioEn: Is the plan too expensive? On the contrary, I think it will save money.
items.audioZh: 這個計畫太貴了嗎？正好相反，我認為它會省錢。
items.questionZh: 說話者對這個計畫有什麼看法？

items.sentenceEn: Learning a new language is always worthwhile.
items.sentenceZh: 學一種新語言永遠是值得的。

items.sentenceEn: The sign is misleading, so many drivers take the wrong exit.
items.sentenceZh: 這個標誌會誤導人，所以很多駕駛走錯出口。

items.stemEn: This job ____ you to work on weekends.
items.stemZh: 這份工作要求你週末上班。

items.stemEn: After a long talk, they finally made a ____ to sell the house.
items.stemZh: 談了很久之後，他們終於決定把房子賣掉。

items.passageEn: Jason had to make a big decision: should he leave his safe job and start his own business? His family thought it was a risk. Some friends even misled him by saying it would be easy. Instead of rushing in, Jason took a careful approach. He first determined the total amount of money the business would require. After one year of planning, he decided it was worthwhile. Today, his small company is doing well.
items.passageZh: Jason 得做一個重大決定：要不要離開穩定的工作，自己創業？他的家人認為這有風險。有些朋友甚至誤導他，說創業很容易。Jason 沒有貿然行動，而是採取了謹慎的方式。他先算出創業總共需要多少錢。經過一年的規劃，他認為值得一試。現在，他的小公司經營得很好。

questions.questionZh: Jason 的家人怎麼看他的計畫？
Jason 一開始先做了什麼？
options: 找好朋友一起合夥開店
向銀行借一大筆錢開店

items.promptZh: 這個決定需要更多時間。
referenceEn: The decision will require more time.
rubricZh: require 表示「需要」，後面直接接名詞（例如 requires more time）
主詞是單數，現在式用 requires
寫 needs 意思也正確

items.promptZh: 這門課很難，但我覺得很值得。
referenceEn: This course is hard, but I think it is worthwhile.
The course is difficult, but I feel it is worthwhile.
rubricZh: 用 worthwhile 表示「值得的」（例如 it is worthwhile；寫 worth it、worth taking 也正確）
「我覺得」可寫，例如 I think、I feel 等
